spans.s: वि-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, arranged, settled, &c. See s. v.

विहित 1. वि-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-धा),
distributed, apportioned, bestowed; put in order,
arranged, appointed, determined, fixed, settled, pre-
scribed, enjoined, enacted, decreed, ordained, ordered;
proper to be done; deposited, placed; done, per-
formed, undertaken, acted, made; framed, con-
structed, formed; furnished with, possessed of.
—वि-
हित-दुर्ग-रचन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has en-
joined the building of a fortress.
—विहितागस् (˚त-
आग्˚), आस्, आस्, अस्, one who has committed a fault,
offending, faulty, wicked.
—विहिताञ्जलि (˚त-अञ्˚),
इस्, इस्, इ, making a respectful obeisance.

विहित 2. वि-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि privative
+ हित), improper, unfit, unsuitable, not good.

विहग विह-ग, विहङ्-ग, &c. See वि-ह
under 1. वि-हा below.

विहन् वि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति (ep. even cl.
4. P. -हन्यति), -हन्तुम्, to strike apart, separate;
to strike down, strike violently, strike; to destroy
utterly, kill, destroy; to afflict; to oppose, impede,
resist; to strike back, reject, refuse, deny; to hinder,
interrupt, obstruct: Caus. -घातयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to be killed or destroyed; to afflict, drive into
straits.

वि-हत्, f. a cow that miscarries from unseasonable
gestation.

वि-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, killed, completely
destroyed; hurt; opposed, impeded, resisted; (अस्),
m. a Buddhist or Jaina temple.

वि-हति, इस्, f. striking, killing; defeat; failure;
(इस्), m. a friend, companion.

वि-हनन, अम्, n. the act of striking; killing
outright; hurting, injury; opposition, obstruction,
impediment; a bow for cleaning cotton; [cf. तूल-
कार्मुक.]

विहर वि-हर, &c. See under वि-हृ,
col. 3.

वि-हर, अस्, m. taking away; expanding, going
apart or in different directions, separation, disunion,
absence; changing, exchanging.
विहार वि-हार, &c. See वि-हृ below.

वि-हार, अस्, m. taking away, removing; expan-
sion, opening; too great expansion of the organs of
speech (consisting in too great lengthening or drawl-
ing in pronunciation; opposed to सं-हार; cf.
व्य्-आस); walking for pleasure or amusement, taking
an airing, wandering, roaming, gadding, going about;
sporting, play, sport, recreation, pastime, pleasure,
relaxation; a pleasure-garden, garden; a Buddhist or
Jaina temple or convent (originally the hall where
[]
the Buddhist priests met or walked about; afterwards
these halls were used as temples, and sometimes be-
came the centre of a whole monastic establishment);
a temple; the palace of Indra or a banner (= वै-
जयन्त?); a palace; N. of a district; the shoulder;
a sort of bird, = विन्दु-रेखक; (in Vedic ritual)
a term for varying a verse (by taking it to pieces,
joining to each of its Pādas a Pāda taken from
another verse, and reciting both parts in such a way
as if they formed only one verse; cf. व्य्-अतिमर्श).
—विहार-गृह, अम्, n. a pleasure-house, play-
house, theatre.
—विहार-भूमि, इस्, f. ground or
place for roaming about, grazing ground, pasturage.
—विहार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, taking pleasure or relax-
ation, enjoying one's self.

वीहार वीहार, अस्, m. (for वि-हार, q. v.), a
temple, sanctuary, (especially) a Jaina or Buddhist
convent or temple.

विहर्ष वि-हर्ष, अस्, m. excessive joy or
gladness, pleasure.
2. वि-हर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, joyless, mournful.
विहव वि-हव. See under वि-ह्वे, p. 953.
वि-हव, अस्, m., Ved. an invocation, invitation.

विहव्य वि-हव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be
offered; (अस्), m., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras
(author of Ṛg-veda

वि-हव्य; add — to be invoked or invited, (in this
sense fr. हु = rt. ह्वे.)

विहस् वि-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -हसितुम्,
to laugh gently, smile, laugh; to laugh at (with
acc.).
वि-हसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, laughing, smiling.

वि-हसन, अम्, n. laughing gently, smiling (=
मध्यम-हास्य), laughing.

वि-हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, smiled, laughed; smiled
at; (अम्), n. a gentle laugh, smile, laugh.

वि-हस्य, ind. having smiled; laughing at, ridi-
culing, contemning.

वि-हस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being laughed at,
being smiled upon.
वि-हास, अस्, m. a gentle laugh, smile.

विहस्त वि-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, handless, help-
less; confounded, perplexed, bewildered; wise,
learned.

विहा 1. वि-हा, cl. 3. A. -जिहीते, &c., Ved.
to go apart, (Sāy. वि-जिहीष्व = वि-गच्छ, Ṛg-
veda

), become expanded, open, gape open
(Lat. dehisco, Gr. χαίνω).
2. वि-हा, ind. (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 36

. fr.
1. वि-हा), heaven, paradise, sky.

विहा 3. वि-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति (2nd sing.
Impv. वि-जहीहि, Kirāt.
XI. 31

), -हातुम्, to relin-
quish, quit, abandon, leave, give up or lay aside
entirely, lose: Caus. -हापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
quit or abandon.

वि-ह (for 2. वि-हा below), the sky, air (only
used in comps.).
—विह-ग, अस्, m. ‘sky-goer,’ a
bird; a cloud; an arrow; the sun; the moon; a
planet.
—विहगोपघुष्ट (˚ग-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
resounding with (the notes) of birds, resonant with
birds.
—विहङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, sky-going, flying,
going swiftly; (अस्), m. a bird; a cloud; an arrow;
the sun; the moon.
—विहङ्-गम, अस्, m. ‘sky-
goer,’ a bird; the sun; (आ), f. a pole or yoke for
carrying burdens (= भार-यष्टि).
—विहङ्ग-
राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the birds,’ epithet of Garuḍa
(the vehicle of Viṣṇu).

विहङ्गिका, f. a sort of pole or yoke for carrying
burdens.

वि-हायस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (probably formed fr. 1. वि-हा
above, as 1. धायस् fr. rt. 1. धा), ‘expanding,’
extensive, vast, great (= महत् according to Naigh.
III. 3

), all-pervading; (Sāy. = विविध-गमन-
युक्त); (perhaps) going quickly, impetuous, spirited,
active; (आस्, अस्), m. n. the open air, air, space (Gr.
χάος), sky, atmosphere; (आस्), m. a bird.

वि-हायस, अस्, अम्, m. n. heaven, sky, atmo-
sphere; (अस्), m. a bird.

वि-हायसा, ind. (inst. c. of वि-हायस् above),
through the sky or air; heaven, sky, atmosphere.

वि-हापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to abandon or give
up; made to yield, extorted, given up, given; (अम्),
n. gift, donation.
वि-हाय, ind. having abandoned or left.
वि-हायत, अम्, n. (?), donation, gift.

वि-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, entirely abandoned, left,
deserted, destitute, bereaved, deprived of, void or
devoid of, free from, without.
—विहीन-ता, f. the
state of being wholly abandoned, abandonment.
—वि-
हीन-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, low-born, base-born, brutish.
विहीन वि-हीन. See under 3. वि-हा above.

विहिंस् वि-हिंस्, cl. 7. 1. P. -हिनस्ति, -हिंसति,
-हिंसितुम्, to injure severely, injure, hurt, damage.
वि-हिंसक, अस्, इका, अम्, injuring, hurting.

वि-हिंसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, injuring, harming, hurt-
ing.
वि-हिंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, injured, hurt, &c.

विहित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has performed
or undertaken.

वि-हिति, इस्, f. action, performance, acting, doing;
arrangement.
विहित्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, done according to rule.

विहुत्मती वि-हुत्-मती, f. (a Kvip formation
fr. rt. हु with prep. वि and affix मत्), a special
oblation or offering, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
1. 134, 6. विहुत्मतीनाम् = विशेषेण होमवती-
नाम् or else आह्वानवतीनाम्.)

विहृ वि-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-
तुम्, to take away, remove, destroy; to go in
various directions; to walk or roam about or ramble
for pleasure, saunter, amuse or divert one's self, sport,
(in Ṛg-veda 1. 28, 7. विजर्भृतस् = विशेषेण
पुनः पुनर् विहारं कुरुतः); to vary, change,
alternate, mix; to spend or pass (time &c.); to
live.

वि-हरण, अम्, n. the act of taking away or
removing, taking; going about for pleasure or exer-
cise, rambling, roaming, taking a walk or airing;
expatiating; relaxation, pastime, pleasure.

वि-हरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken away; to be
rambled or sported.

वि-हरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaming for pleasure,
sauntering about, ranging at large.

वि-हर्तृ, ता, m. one who takes away, a robber;
one who rambles about, rambling, roaming; a roamer.
वि-हर्तृ; add — one who amuses himself.

विहारक or विहारिक, अस्, इका, अम्, roaming or
walking about, a roamer; belonging to a Buddhist
temple or convent.

विहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, expanding; taking pleasure or
relaxation, wandering or roaming about for pleasure,
enjoying one's self; beautiful.

वि-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, expanded; sported, played;
taken out, transposed, varied, (in Vedic ritual applied
to the transposing of the Pādas in singing the Ṣo-
ḍaśī hymns, see वि-हार); (अम्), n. one of the ten
blandishments or feminine modes of indicating love,
hesitation or reluctance to avow feelings to a lover,
(some of the others are लीला, ललित, कुट्टमित,
मोट्टायित, वि-च्छित्ति, किल-किञ्चित, &c., q. q. v. v.)

वि-हृति, इस्, f. taking away; opening, expansion;
sport, pastime, pleasure.

वि-हृत्य, ind. having opened or spread out,
having expanded; having roamed about or sported,
having rambled, having disported.

विहेठ वि-हेठ, अस्, m. (see rt. हेठ्), hurt,
injury; the act of afflicting or harassing.

वि-हेठक, अस्, m. an injurer, one who inflicts
pain or injury on another; a reviler.

वि-हेठन, अम्, n. the act of injuring, hurting,
wounding, killing; afflicting, distressing; rubbing,
grinding; injury, harm, pain, sorrow, affliction.

विह्रु वि-ह्रु (ह्रु = ह्वृ, cf. वि-ह्वृ below),
cl. 9. P. -ह्रुणाति, &c., Ved. to injure, hurt, destroy,
(Sāy. वि-ह्रुणाति = वि-ह्वरति, Ṛg-veda

वि-ह्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. injured, hurt, spoiled
[cf. अ-व्˚]; fractured, dissevered, (Sāy. = वि-च्छिन्न,
वि-बाधित.)

विह्लण विह्लण, अस्, m., N. of a native of
Kaśmīra (author of the following poem).
—विह्लण-
काव्य, अम्, n. ‘the poem of Vihlaṇa,’ N. of a poem
(containing the Caura-pañcāśikā, said to have been
recited when Vihlaṇa was on the point of being put
to death by king Vīra-siṃha, whose daughter he had
secretly espoused).

विह्वल् वि-ह्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ह्वलति, -ह्वलि-
तुम्, to shake or move about, stagger, tremble, be
agitated.

वि-ह्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking about, agitated,
alarmed, perturbed, disquieted, confused, overcome
with fear, beside one's self, delirious; distressed,
afflicted; languishing; desponding; fused, liquid.
—विह्वल-ता, f. or विह्वल-त्व, अम्, n. agitation,
perturbation, consternation, anxiety.
—विह्वली-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, made confused or agitated; fused, liquid.
विह्वलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, trembling, agitated.

वि-ह्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated, alarmed, stag-
gering.

विह्वृ वि-ह्वृ, cl. 1. P. -ह्वरति, -ह्वर्तुम्,
Ved. to be crooked, curved; to hurt (?).

विह्वे वि-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, &c.,
to call upon, invoke, worship.
विहिंस-ता, f. injury, hurt.
वि-हिंसन, अम्, n. the act of injuring, injury.
वि-हिंसा, f. injury, hurt.
वि-हिंस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, injurious, noxious, hurtful.
